en.gc.resources.guide.start.title: Your first workbook, without the blank-page feeling.
en.gc.resources.guide.start.description: Open an XLSX file, edit a few cells and save a copy you can keep.
en.gc.resources.guide.start.step1: Keep the original workbook as a backup. In the browser workspace, use the file-open control and select a .xlsx file from your computer.
en.gc.resources.guide.start.step2: Choose a worksheet tab. Click a cell and type a value, or double-click a cell to edit its current content.
en.gc.resources.guide.start.step3: Select a number cell and inspect its formula in the formula bar. Check a few important totals against your original workbook.
en.gc.resources.guide.start.step4: Use the save or export control to download an XLSX copy. Reopen that file and check your edits before replacing your original.
en.gc.resources.guide.start.note: The browser workspace processes files locally. Closing or refreshing the tab can discard unsaved changes.
en.gc.resources.guide.formulas.title: A small formula can do a lot.
en.gc.resources.guide.formulas.description: Use SUM for a total and IF to turn a number into a useful decision.
en.gc.resources.guide.formulas.step1: In a blank sheet, enter Amount in A1. Put 120, 85 and 45 in A2, A3 and A4.
en.gc.resources.guide.formulas.step2: Select A5 and enter =SUM(A2:A4). Press Enter. The result should be 250.
en.gc.resources.guide.formulas.step3: In B2, enter =IF(A2>100,"Review","OK"). A2 contains 120, so B2 should show Review.
en.gc.resources.guide.formulas.step4: Change A2 to 90. A5 should update to 220 and B2 to OK. Save an XLSX copy when you finish.
en.gc.resources.guide.formulas.note: Start with simple formulas and verify the result. Some Excel functions and advanced workbook features are not supported in the alpha.
en.gc.resources.guide.analysis.title: Give your numbers a new perspective.
en.gc.resources.guide.analysis.description: Prepare a small data table, then explore charts and PivotTables in the desktop app.
en.gc.resources.guide.analysis.step1: In the desktop app, create headers Category and Amount in A1:B1. Add Travel / 120, Supplies / 85 and Travel / 45 in rows 2 to 4.
en.gc.resources.guide.analysis.step2: Select A1:B4 and use the chart command from the toolbar or Insert menu. Choose a column chart, then check that the amounts and category labels match the cells.
en.gc.resources.guide.analysis.step3: With the same source range, open the PivotTable command. Use Category as the row field and Amount as a value field, summarized by SUM.
en.gc.resources.guide.analysis.step4: Check the summary: Travel should total 165 and Supplies 85. Save the workbook and reopen a copy to verify the result.
en.gc.resources.guide.analysis.note: Chart and PivotTable controls can change between alpha releases. This guide describes the desktop workflow; the browser workspace offers a simpler editing experience.

en.gc.resources.faq.title: A few things worth knowing.
en.gc.resources.faq.description: The practical details, before your next workbook.
en.gc.resources.faq.free.q: Is Gridcraft free and open source?
en.gc.resources.faq.free.a: Yes. The upstream Gridcraft project is free to use and dual-licensed under MIT and Apache 2.0. Its source code is available on GitHub.
en.gc.resources.faq.affiliation.q: Is this the official Gridcraft website?
en.gc.resources.faq.affiliation.a: No. This is an independent learning site and browser workspace. Gridcraft is developed by the upstream Storytold / ArtCraft project. Official downloads link directly to its GitHub releases.
en.gc.resources.faq.compatibility.q: Can I open my existing Excel files?
en.gc.resources.faq.compatibility.a: Gridcraft uses XLSX as its native format, but it is still in alpha. Complex formatting, advanced formulas and other Excel features may not round-trip exactly. Test a copy and keep your original file.
en.gc.resources.faq.browser.q: Where do files go in the browser workspace?
en.gc.resources.faq.browser.a: Workbook processing happens locally in your browser. Use the editor’s save or export control to download your changes as XLSX. Closing or refreshing the tab can lose unsaved work.
en.gc.resources.faq.macros.a: No. Gridcraft does not support VBA macros. Keep macro-dependent workbooks in a tool that supports them, such as desktop Microsoft Excel.

zh.gc.resources.guide.start.title: 轻松开始你的第一个工作簿。
zh.gc.resources.guide.start.description: 打开 XLSX 文件，编辑单元格，然后保存一份自己的副本。
zh.gc.resources.guide.start.step1: 先备份原始工作簿。在浏览器工作空间使用打开文件的控件，选择电脑中的 .xlsx 文件。
zh.gc.resources.guide.start.step2: 选择工作表标签。点击单元格输入数值，或双击单元格编辑已有内容。
zh.gc.resources.guide.start.step3: 选择数值单元格，在公式栏中检查公式。将关键合计与原始工作簿进行对照。
zh.gc.resources.guide.start.step4: 使用保存或导出控件下载 XLSX 副本。重新打开并检查修改，再决定是否替换原文件。
zh.gc.resources.guide.start.note: 浏览器工作空间在本地处理文件。关闭或刷新标签页可能丢失未保存的修改。
zh.gc.resources.guide.formulas.title: 小公式，也能帮大忙。
zh.gc.resources.guide.formulas.description: 用 SUM 计算总数，用 IF 根据数值作出判断。
zh.gc.resources.guide.formulas.step1: 在空白工作表的 A1 输入 Amount，在 A2、A3、A4 分别输入 120、85、45。
zh.gc.resources.guide.formulas.step2: 选择 A5，输入 =SUM(A2:A4)，按回车，结果应为 250。
zh.gc.resources.guide.formulas.step3: 在 B2 输入 =IF(A2>100,"Review","OK")。A2 为 120，因此 B2 应显示 Review。
zh.gc.resources.guide.formulas.step4: 将 A2 改为 90。A5 应更新为 220，B2 应显示 OK。完成后保存 XLSX 副本。
zh.gc.resources.guide.formulas.note: 先尝试简单公式并验证结果。Alpha 版本尚不支持所有 Excel 函数与高级工作簿功能。
zh.gc.resources.guide.analysis.title: 换个角度理解数字。
zh.gc.resources.guide.analysis.description: 整理一张小数据表，在桌面应用中探索图表和数据透视表。
zh.gc.resources.guide.analysis.step1: 在桌面应用的 A1:B1 输入表头 Category 和 Amount。在第 2 至 4 行填入 Travel / 120、Supplies / 85、Travel / 45。
zh.gc.resources.guide.analysis.step2: 选择 A1:B4，使用工具栏或插入菜单中的图表命令。选择柱状图，检查金额与分类标签是否与单元格一致。
zh.gc.resources.guide.analysis.step3: 使用相同数据区域打开数据透视表命令。将 Category 设为行字段，Amount 设为值字段，汇总方式选择 SUM。
zh.gc.resources.guide.analysis.step4: 检查汇总结果：Travel 应为 165，Supplies 应为 85。保存工作簿，再重新打开副本验证结果。
zh.gc.resources.guide.analysis.note: 图表和数据透视表控件可能随 Alpha 版本变化。本指南介绍桌面操作流程，浏览器工作空间提供较简化的编辑体验。

zh.gc.resources.faq.title: 开始前，你可能想知道。
zh.gc.resources.faq.description: 打开下一份工作簿之前，先了解这些实用信息。
zh.gc.resources.faq.free.a: 是的。官方 Gridcraft 项目可免费使用，采用 MIT 与 Apache 2.0 双重许可，源码可在 GitHub 获取。
zh.gc.resources.faq.affiliation.q: 这是 Gridcraft 官方网站吗？
zh.gc.resources.faq.affiliation.a: 不是。这是独立学习网站与浏览器工作空间。Gridcraft 由官方 Storytold / ArtCraft 项目开发，下载链接直接指向其 GitHub 发布页面。
zh.gc.resources.faq.compatibility.q: 可以打开已有的 Excel 文件吗？
zh.gc.resources.faq.compatibility.a: Gridcraft 原生使用 XLSX 格式，但仍处于 Alpha 阶段。复杂格式、高级公式及其他 Excel 功能可能无法完整保留。请使用副本测试并保留原文件。
zh.gc.resources.faq.browser.q: 浏览器工作空间中的文件会去哪里？
zh.gc.resources.faq.browser.a: 工作簿在浏览器中本地处理。使用编辑器的保存或导出控件，将修改下载为 XLSX 文件。关闭或刷新标签页可能丢失未保存的工作。
zh.gc.resources.faq.macros.a: 不能。Gridcraft 不支持 VBA 宏。依赖宏的工作簿请继续使用支持 VBA 的工具，例如桌面版 Microsoft Excel。
